name: recon
description: EXAMPLE: a reconstructed HMI. Copy to targets/recon.json and edit the URLs/adapters. The harness only uses these fields; nothing about the reconstruction's internals is assumed.
notes: mint_token must print a 64-hex token on stdout and make it valid for the target's WSS validator.
state must print a JSON object with the same shape as `vg state` for the fields scenarios select (guest.leds, guest.backlight, esp.requests, espjson.*).
shell receives the command on stdin and must print stdout, exit 0.

If the reconstruction cannot expose a shell, drop the keys that need it: scenarios 02, 03 (sysfs), 04 (db), 05 (files), 06 (EspWifiConfig) and 08 will record 'target has no shell adapter' instead of failing.
